lines: Though I advance, it is a da capo al segno
Beyond the door, I saw my own back
Where I turned, I saw hope
Where is the end of hell?
Round and round and round and round
I appeased my hunger with a fallen pomegranate
A ringing sound came from inside my skull
If nothing changes no matter how much I advance
What is the meaning of resisting?
Round and round and round and round
Into the depths of a mad dream
